snippet.title: Girl Rescue: Dragon Out! (by WONDER GROUP) IOS Gameplay Video (HD)
snippet.description:
App description:

Are you ready to start the rescue operation? Welcome to Girl Rescue: Dragon Out!, a brain-challenging puzzle game that combines leisure and challenge! You need to have good strategies to stop the invasion of the dragon and protect our girls!

Your goal in Girl Rescue is to use cannons to stop the dragon invasion and keep our girls unharmed. It is very easy to play and will also test your reflexes and matching skills!

Game play:
- Click on the correct color cannon
- The cannon will destroy the corresponding color parts of the dragon and slow down the invasion.
- The dragon is repelled and the girl is safe.

Game features:
* Nervous and exciting rhythm: Your hesitation may eventually lead to the girl being attacked by the dragon. You need to find the correct color cannon to attack the dragon within the limited time.
* Simple operation and smooth animation: new players can easily get started and can pass the level with a simple click
* Interesting and highly fulfilling: When the dragon is defeated and the girl is rescued, you will have an unprecedented sense of accomplishment

* Various random events occur: During the game, you may encounter problems such as frozen dragons, cannon jams, etc., which will make the game more fun!
* Levels with different difficulties: Different levels have different scenes and different difficulties, which constantly brings freshness!

If you like casual puzzle games and want some challenge while relaxing, then this game is definitely for you! Download and enjoy Girl Rescue: Dragon Out!!

App Store Link:https://apps.apple.com/us/app/girl-rescue-dragon-out/id6739560182
